result.title: ExGrad: Beyond Suppression - Explicit Clean-Gradient Subtraction in Adversarial Training
result.summary: Adversarial training derives updates from surrogate losses, but source-loss descent does not directly characterize an update's effect on adversarial margins. We introduce ExGrad (extrapolative gradient recomposition), which constructs clean-input, adversarial-input, and adversarial-weight-perturbed (AWP) gradients. Virtual steps measure their margin responses, and a globally solvable three-variable problem selects coefficients over a bounded affine domain without nonnegativity constraints. Across affine radii on CIFAR-10, negative clean coefficients rapidly predominate and increase in magnitude with the radius. Cross-zero interventions show that setting the clean coefficient to zero is insufficient: mild subtraction improves PGD-20, while stronger subtraction trades clean accuracy for further PGD-20 gains. In CIFAR-10 WRN-28-4 controls, none of the three candidate-removal variants matches full ExGrad. Projection diagnostics show that negative clean coefficients usually coexist with positive net clean-axis projections, although both decrease as the radius grows. Norm-matched controls indicate that update magnitude alone does not explain the moderate-radius gains. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100 show radius-dependent improvements over AWP. On CIFAR-100, ExGrad at $R=0.8$ improves all five reported metrics, including clean and AutoAttack accuracy by 3.84 and 1.75 percentage points. On ImageNet-100, the same radius improves all four robust metrics over both AWP and PGD-AT. These results identify clean-gradient subtraction as a response-revealed update preference whose strength and clean-robust operating point are controlled by the affine radius.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExGrad，将干净输入、对抗输入与 AWP 三类梯度做外推式重组，用虚拟步测量各自的 margin 响应，并在有界仿射域上求解三元系数；实验显示负的干净梯度系数随半径增大而占主导，在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet-100 上取得随半径变化的鲁棒性提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 以目标指标响应而非固定权重来挑选梯度组合系数，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留与推理更新的贡献分配、训练期监督提供可核查线索，但该文属对抗鲁棒训练，与视觉推理无直接关联。
